class ProviderState(TypedDict):
    state: Literal["ready", "degraded", "not_ready"]
    kind: str | None
    ready: bool
    can_serve: bool
    refresh_in_flight: NotRequired[bool]
    cannot_serve_since: NotRequired[float]
    cached_token_time_to_expiry_seconds: NotRequired[float]
    seconds_since_last_refresh: NotRequired[float]
    refresh_age_measured_from: NotRequired[Literal["broker_start", "last_refresh"]]
    refresh_role: NotRequired[str]
    refresh_owner: NotRequired[str | None]
    refresh_owner_role: NotRequired[str | None]
    refresh_owner_heartbeat_at: NotRequired[float | None]
    refresh_due_at: NotRequired[float | None]
    worker_grant_fetched_at: NotRequired[float]
    worker_grant_fingerprint: NotRequired[str]
    first_failed_at: NotRequired[float]
    last_failed_at: NotRequired[float]
    time_to_expiry_seconds: NotRequired[float]
    stale_window_expired: NotRequired[bool]
    refresh_stale: NotRequired[bool]
    refresh_stale_reason: NotRequired[str]
    credential_source: NotRequired[str]
    seconds_left: NotRequired[float]
    last_token_failure: NotRequired[dict[str, object]]

class ReadyzPayload(RollStatusPayload):
    status: Literal["ready", "degraded", "not_ready"]
    auth: dict[str, object]
    providers: dict[str, bool]
    provider_states: dict[str, ProviderState]
    providers_detail: dict[str, object]
    store_errors: dict[str, object]
    instance: dict[str, object]
    degraded_providers: NotRequired[dict[str, str]]
    disabled_providers: NotRequired[list[str]]
    absent_providers: NotRequired[dict[str, str]]
    upstream_acceptance: NotRequired[dict[str, object]]
